label: Multi-storey apartment / office block from stackable modules
description: Stack a building from one module family: one Base (ground floor, often with door), N Floor modules on top (y += storey height from bounds.size.y), a Roof module on top, corners from the family's Corner pieces for L/U plans, fire escapes and roof access/props as dressing. Alternatively use a pre-stacked *_Stack_* shell as a whole. Street face +Z; do not scale; keep one family per building so textures match.

steps.note: Ground storey. Prefer a Door piece on the street face; Base pieces for families that have them.
Same family as base. y = cumulative bounds.size.y of pieces below (~3 m each).
Top. Roof_Corner variants for corner plans.
Use at plan corners, same family; stack Corner -> Roof_Corner.
Entrance stairs/planters at the base on the street face.
Alternative to base/floor/roof: a whole pre-stacked building.
On a side face, spanning the floors.
Aircon units, vents, roof access; seat on the flat roof pad, never tilted.
